report.explanation: Current evidence shows healthy signals: payment checkout span OK at 63ms, order error_rate 0.001 with p95 75ms and zero dependency timeouts, and a valid inventory deployment 639 minutes old. No observation substantiates any taxonomy cause, and the deployment record alone cannot establish latency. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; hand off for the missing telemetry.
missing_evidence: Checkout/gateway error-rate and latency metrics for the alert window to confirm the alert is real
Order service error-rate and p95 time series over a longer window to detect degradation
Payment service error counts and p95 latency beyond a single OK span
Inventory service metrics (error rate, latency, redis timeouts) to assess the 3.3.7 deployment
Redis and postgresql dependency health/timeout metrics for order and inventory
